description:
• Brand introduction: At khaplupet.com, we specialize in high-quality pet supplies and accessories that ensure your furry friends live their best life. From comfortable beds to fun toys and essential grooming products, we offer everything your pets need to stay happy, healthy, and active.
• Product description: Our products are carefully selected to meet the needs of all pets, from dogs and cats to smaller animals. We offer a wide range of pet supplies, including grooming tools, toys, and health essentials. Each product is designed for durability, comfort, and safety.
• USP (Unique Selling Point): We offer premium-quality, affordable pet accessories that are made with your pet’s well-being in mind. Our products are chosen for their functionality, style, and safety, ensuring that pets enjoy the best care and comfort every day. We provide free shipping on orders over $50 to ensure your pets get the care they deserve without any added costs.
• Payment terms: Affiliates earn a 10% commission on every sale made through their referral link. Payments are processed via PayPal on a monthly basis, with a minimum payout threshold of $50. Affiliates will receive payments for all confirmed and completed transactions.
• Other information: We provide affiliates with marketing materials including banners, product images, and promotional content to make it easy to promote our products. Affiliates also have access to dedicated support for any inquiries or help they may need.
